tools.name: genesis_status
tools.description: Live status of the PairMine Genesis round, read from PairCore on BSC. Returns how many of the 888 Genesis miners are sold and remaining, whether the Genesis window and the sale itself are open, public sale progress, and whether the liquidity pool has been created.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Check a BSC address against the PairMine gates, read from chain: AgentGate.isEligible, trial-miner claimed, Genesis-list qualification by the published rule, and Genesis mints used / remaining under the 10-per-address cap.

tools.name: tier_price
tools.description: Public-sale tier pricing from PairCore. With no arguments: the current tier and its exact price. Pass tier (1 to 40) for that tier's price, and/or quote_qty for the contract quote() total that walks the ladder.

tools.name: mint_instructions
tools.description: How an agent mints PairMine miners (summary of the official skill at https://pairmineai.com/SKILL.md): the Genesis path, the public path, the trial miner, caps and safety rules.

tools.name: project_info
tools.description: PairMine project and contract directory (static, published data).
